## 专业说明 {#overview}

<p><strong>官方名称：</strong>Bachelor of Music</p>

<p><strong>授予学位 / 项目类型：</strong>Bachelor of Music</p>

<p><strong>目录适用期：</strong>2027招生；费用逐条标明2027或2026；培养页面为核验日公开版本</p>

<p><strong>目录条目类别：</strong>degree</p>

<p><strong>申请路径：</strong>Bachelor entry degree published in 2027 university guide</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>学位与方向：</strong>音乐学位包含作曲、互动媒体作曲、爵士与即兴、音乐学与民族音乐学、音乐研究综合方向、演奏与演唱。音乐学与民族音乐学、音乐研究综合方向的2027选拔专页要求先申请 Performance，之后才可能转入。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-interactive-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-jazz-and-improvisation">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-music-studies">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-performance">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-music-studies">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>学制、校区与语言：</strong>各方向公开国际课程页列全日制3年、Southbank面授；学校授课型课程以英语教学。具体开学月份按方向核对。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-interactive-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-jazz-and-improvisation">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-music-studies">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-offering-bachelor-of-music-performance">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-music-studies">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-language-statement-expanded">官方依据</a></p>

## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>英语：</strong>本科英语分组表将本学位列为 IELTS Academic 6.5、四项各6.0；获认可替代方法另核。创作选拔及中学资格要求必须查看具体方向。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-melbourne-undergraduate-english">官方依据</a></p>

<details class="school-policy"><summary>学校共用规则 · 请核对适用资格和年度</summary>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>大陆普高与高考：</strong>官网中国学生页面明确目前不接受高考直接入读本科。中国普通高中学生通常考虑Trinity College Foundation Studies；持认可IB、A-level等资格者可按该资格申请。预科录取不等于本科升读获保证。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-melbourne-profile-browser-china">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>本科英语分组：</strong>官方本科英语表将农业、文学、生物医学、商科、设计、艺术、音乐和理学列为IELTS Academic总分6.5、四项各6.0；口腔健康为7.0、四项各7.0。原住民延伸或特殊入口须另核适用。测试替代与资格有效期按个人背景评估。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-melbourne-undergraduate-english">官方依据</a></p>

</details>

## 申请安排 {#applications}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>2027选拔：</strong>各方向2027年初入学在2026-09-28截止课程及创作材料申请；回调、面试与作品要求按方向不同。截至核验日该截止未到。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-interactive-composition">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-jazz-and-improvisation">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-music-studies">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-creative-bachelor-of-music-performance">官方依据</a></p>

## 学费与资助 {#fees}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>按具体方向收费：</strong>本总览不能提供适用于全部方向的统一2027报价。请打开具体方向查看已取得的2027金额或明确标年的2026参考；学费按实际选课计算。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-composition-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-interactive-composition-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-jazz-and-improvisation-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-musicology-and-ethnomusicology-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-music-studies-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-p-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-music-performance-fees">官方依据</a></p>

<details class="school-policy"><summary>学校共用规则 · 请核对适用资格和年度</summary>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>学费计算范围：</strong>国际本科按所读科目的学科费率与学分收费，课程页的首年和全程金额为估算，学费每年复核；全程估算一般已含估计涨幅。请查具体学位和年份，主修费用不应在学位费上重复加计。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-melbourne-page-bachelor-of-arts-fees">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-melbourne-arts-fees-international">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>2027本科优秀奖学金：</strong>Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship为2027入学本科提供全课程20%学费减免，至少140个名额。须已获Overseas Fee本科录取，未有高等教育经历（Year12延伸学习除外），按课程入学成绩择优，申请课程后自动考虑；不能与其他学费减免或资助叠加。获奖者通常在课程录取后五个工作日内获通知，未获奖者不另通知，不应预设可获奖。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-melbourne-excellence-scholarship">官方依据</a></p>

</details>

## 毕业生情况 {#outcomes}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>毕业方向与统计范围：</strong>职业路径随所选方向而异，涉及艺术创作、表演、制作、音乐研究及相关行业。本轮未取得能按本学位方向、毕业届次及国际生样本计算的就业或薪酬调查。</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>实践机会与毕业统计：</strong>中国学生页介绍学生在校实习及职业支持；这些是可参与的培养机会，不是中国本科生就业率。本轮未取得按主修、毕业届次、中国国籍和响应样本定义的毕业调查。</p>
